scene_description: A blue-gray two-handled pot sits on a granite counter beside an electric stovetop. Behind it are a black-capped oregano jar, a green-lidded jar of tan-brown spice, green olive oil bottle, blue Celtic salt shaker, and red-capped soy sauce bottle. Glass dishes and utensils lie to the right.
